events.author: Mila
events.text: R17: propose version 2.7.0, codename Lyra. R18 will be 3.0.0.

events.author: Ilya
events.text: R17: first canary eu-west-1, 20 nodes. Do not count a canary as a production release.

events.author: Mila
events.text: R17: draft audit r17-draft.pdf is rejected; signature pending.

events.author: Anton
events.text: R18: owner Anton, codename Vega. Its discussion is separate from R17.

events.author: Ilya
events.text: R17: eu-west-1 canary failed; rollback completed. This region was never released.

events.author: Mila
events.text: R17: approved target changes to 2.7.1. Freeze date is 2024-05-14.

events.author: Nina
events.text: R18: r18-audit-final.pdf is approved. This does not approve the R17 draft.

events.author: Ilya
events.text: R17: production us-east-1 completed; preliminary count 40 nodes.

events.author: Mila
events.text: R17: transfer release ownership to Oleg. Mila remains the final auditor.

events.author: Mila
events.text: R17: r17-audit-final.pdf approved; SHA-256 prefix abc123. This supersedes the rejected draft.

events.author: Oleg
events.text: R17: final customer-facing codename is Orion, replacing Lyra.

events.author: Ilya
events.text: R17: correct us-east-1 production count to 36 nodes. Four of the earlier 40 were staging nodes.

events.author: Nina
events.text: R17: unsigned candidate had checksum prefix dead00. Do not use it; the signed final report remains authoritative.

events.author: Ilya
events.text: R18: production ap-south-1 completed on 12 nodes. Keep counts separate from R17.

events.author: Oleg
events.text: R17: support window is 90 days from release. R18 support window is 180 days.

events.author: Mila
events.text: R17: audit closed. Final report size is 4096 bytes; no additional deployment region was approved.

events.author: Oleg
events.text: R17: change freeze remains unchanged after the codename correction.

events.author: Ilya
events.text: R17: postmortem closed; no additional production nodes were added after the corrected count.
